# namespace_builder_usage (Data Source)

Reads remote builder compute usage, build wall minutes, unit minutes, and day-by-day metrics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_builder_usage" "monthly" {
  period_start = "2026-08-01"
  period_end   = "2026-08-21"
}

output "builder_unit_minutes" {
  value = data.namespace_builder_usage.monthly.total.build_unit_minutes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `period_start` (String) Start date for usage period in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

### Optional

- `period_end` (String) End date for usage period in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (optional, defaults to current date).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this usage query in Terraform state.
- `pending_total` (Attributes) Pending / unfinalized builder usage for the period. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pending_total))
- `per_day` (Attributes List) Daily breakdown of builder usage, sorted chronologically. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--per_day))
- `total` (Attributes) Finalized total builder usage for the period. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total))

<a id="nestedatt--pending_total"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pending_total`

Read-Only:

- `build_count` (Number) Pending build count.
- `build_unit_minutes` (Number) Pending compute unit minutes.
- `build_wall_minutes` (Number) Pending elapsed wall minutes.


<a id="nestedatt--per_day"></a>
### Nested Schema for `per_day`

Read-Only:

- `build_count` (Number) Number of builds executed on this day.
- `build_unit_minutes` (Number) Compute unit minutes consumed on this day.
- `build_wall_minutes` (Number) Elapsed wall minutes on this day.
- `date` (String) Calendar date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
- `pending_build_count` (Number) Pending build count for this day.
- `pending_build_unit_minutes` (Number) Pending unit minutes for this day.
- `pending_build_wall_minutes` (Number) Pending wall minutes for this day.


<a id="nestedatt--total"></a>
### Nested Schema for `total`

Read-Only:

- `build_count` (Number) Total number of builds executed.
- `build_unit_minutes` (Number) Total compute unit minutes consumed.
- `build_wall_minutes` (Number) Total elapsed wall minutes across all builds.
